source_facts: The test creates its independent witness and Node before generating a complete maintenance/W1 packet and sending the first valid TCP request.
The witness child services a persistent Unix connection with serve_one deadline min(fixture_end, now+10s); after a service error it closes that connection. Its fixture lifetime is60s.
The TCP service lifetime is30s and each accepted request has at most10s; the client uses a10s budget.
The TCP service performs durable ingress accounting before consuming the request body and drops the connection on a request-path error.
The test uses a private temporary directory, ephemeral loopback TCP port and a child-specific witness socket; source review found no shared fixed path or port collision explaining this failure.
